description: Check every shader (.gdshader, .gdshaderinc, Shader resources in scenes) two ways: a static review against Godot 4.7's own shader tables (Godot 3 names such as hint_albedo, SCREEN_TEXTURE or WORLD_MATRIX; built-ins in the wrong shader_type or function; read-only built-ins written, such as COLOR in a spatial fragment(); unknown render modes; missing includes; colour uniforms without source_color; performance hints), then a headless compile by real Godot when it is installed (no GPU needed) that adds Godot's own errors (headless Godot runs the full shader compiler). `gpu: true` also draws the shaders on the Compatibility renderer (needs a display, or xvfb-run on Linux; slower) for what only the GPU driver rejects: a uniform block that is too big, a sampler array indexed by a variable, a driver compile or link error. Every line is `res://file:line: severity [rule] message`; [godot] marks the compiler's, [gpu] the driver's. Pass `code` + `file` to check a shader before you save it (the GPU pass draws the file on disk), `files` for some shaders (an include also compiles the shaders that use it), `compile: false` to skip Godot. godot_check `shaders: true` runs the GPU pass over the whole project. godot_migrate rewrites the Godot 3 names; godot_api `shader:spatial.fragment` lists built-ins.

code.description: unsaved shader code, checked in place of the file on disk

compile.description: compile with Godot (default: when Godot is found; true fails without it)

detail.description: brief (capped lists) or full (everything); default brief

file.description: res:// path the code belongs to (required with code)

files.description: only these res:// shaders, includes or scenes

gpu.description: also draw them on the Compatibility renderer, for GPU driver errors (needs a display or xvfb-run)

path.description: project folder, or a file or folder inside it (relative to the server's folder; default: the current project)

name: godot_shader
title: Review and compile shaders
